title: Show a legal bit condition can destroy the semisimple certificate
statement: In M8(F2),D={diag(A,A,B,B):A,B in M2}. A legal right-bit pin adds E13 to the dual. The multiplier becomes the repeated-block algebra with A21=0,isomorphic to UT2(F2) plus M2(F2),with a nonzero square-zero radical.
